description: elec_lead's fatal case (bundle.deobfuscated.js:61245-61290): all four consequences of the extra hit's kill are independent comma-expressions in the source, not an if/else -- a fatal hit still calls afterAttack (elec_chain grants Pikachu +1 speed despite the kill, unlike fairy_opening_volley's ternary which SKIPS afterAttack entirely on a fatal hit, see fairy_opening_volley_multi.json) AND calls traits_config.onKO (poison_pass halves Rattata's 4 poison stacks -- floor(4/2)=2 -- onto the still-alive Spearow) via `this.onKO`, never ability_config.on_ko/on_faint (traits_config has no onFaint method at all; the source never references one here). Rattata's current_hp=1 guarantees the opening hit is fatal regardless of the exact damage roll.
